system.description:
As a bonus action, by spending 1 Actualization Die, you surround yourself with a phantasmic chakra that looks like a suit of chains. The aura radiates off of you, filling a 5 foot radius centered on yourself. This aura does not penetrate cover, walls or barriers. It lasts for 1 minute or until you are incapacitated.

When you interact with Non-Hostile creatures who are within your aura, you gain a Rank of mastery with Intimidation based checks.

Hostile creatures that begin their turn within your aura takes 4 Psychic damage.
